build_BaseTask: build a BaseTask with a Sawyer arm, Robotiq gripper, sensors, and arena using standard_compose
test_BaseTask_observables: test that a BaseTask observables set matches the union of all robot sensor observables
test_BaseTask_observable_types: test that a BaseTask observation spec only contains uint8, int64, or float32 dtypes
test_CastObservable: test that CastObservable correctly casts float64 aggregated observable values to float32 dtype
create_FakePhysics: create a FakePhysics class with step, reset, and observables for unit testing observation updaters
